NotebookLM

Google's research notebook: upload your sources and get grounded answers, summaries and audio overviews.

Key features of NotebookLM

  • Source-grounded answers
  • Audio overviews
  • Citations
  • Study guides
  • Multiple formats

NotebookLM pricing and rating

Pricing: Free / Plus. Plans change often, so check the official site for the latest details. Our editorial rating is 4.7 out of 5.
